items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, really? I didn’t know that.

ctx.x: [Michael] Brecker did that, too, on [the recording] Don't Try This . . . I can’t remember which album it's on that he does The Meaning of the Blues. [It's on Now You See It . . . (Now You Don't).]
Oh, really? I didn’t know that.
